articles.title: Anthony Fauci to face grilling from Senate Republicans on Covid pandemic
articles.description:
Hearing is part of a longtime Republican investigation into pandemic’s origins, led by Senator Rand Paul

Anthony Fauci, the former veteran director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (Niaid) who served as a key adviser to Donald Trump and Joe Biden on the Covid-19 pandemic, is due to testify on Wednesday at a high-profile US Senate hearing.

Senators are expected to question Fauci about whether the Covid-19 virus began as a “lab leak”, a claim virologists have argued is unlikely. The testimony is part of a longtime Republican investigation into the origins of the pandemic, led by Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky.

articles.title: RFK Jr urges Alzheimer’s screening but blunts key panel that could drive research
articles.description:
Experts say evidence for cognitive screening desired by health secretary ‘not great’ as taskforce idle since last year

The US health secretary, Robert F Kennedy Jr, has called for better Alzheimer’s screening – but a critical federal panel that might have helped researchers find practical ways to do that has been prevented from meeting for more than a year.

The panel, formally called the US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF), had planned to issue a recommendation on screening for cognitive decline this year, alongside 13 other topics as varied as autism screening and food allergy prevention.
